moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The kinds of message this instance exchanges with other systems, and what sends and consumes each. A type comes with the integration that speaks it; where its owner allows, its transport options and its handler are chosen here.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此实例与其他系统交换的消息类型，以及各自由什么发送和消耗。类型随负责它的集成而来；若其所有者允许，在此选择其传输选项和处理程序。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The message as it is stored, acted on directly: no owner's registration, eligibility or review applies. Use Recovery above where it offers the action.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 按存储原样直接处理的消息：不适用所有者的登记、资格或复核。若上方的恢复提供了该操作，请使用它。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The message is being consumed in the background
The messages could not be reviewed
The most its waiting items and kept content may take (its own, or the conf's queue-max-megabytes) and its replicated records (its own, or replica-max-rows); at a cap it pauses until Resume
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 其等待项和所保留内容的最大占用（它自己的，或配置的 queue-max-megabytes）及其复制的记录（它自己的，或 replica-max-rows）；达到上限则暂停，直到“继续”

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The most replicated records this node keeps for it, all its sets; past it the pairing pauses. Empty for the conf's replica-max-rows. Saving resumes a paused pairing
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点为它保留的复制记录上限，含其全部集合；超过后配对暂停。留空则用配置的 replica-max-rows。保存会恢复已暂停的配对

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The most the items waiting for this node may take; past it the oldest fail. The content it sends with its deliveries counts against it too: past it the pairing pauses. Empty for the conf's queue-max-megabytes, which holds for each pairing alone
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点等待项的最大占用；超过后最旧的会失败。它随投递发送的内容也计入：超过后配对暂停。留空则用配置的 queue-max-megabytes，它对每个配对单独生效

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The mr-pass sites whose authority this node is
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点作为其权威的 mr-pass 站点

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The name of a claim the provider sends, such as name or email
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 提供商发送的声明名称，例如 name 或 email

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The node displaced from ${pairedNodeId} may link again
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 从 ${pairedNodeId} 被替换的节点可以再次建立链路

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The pairings could not be read
The per-client parts are off: only the global limits apply. Turn them on with enabled="true" on web-protection, or by naming the proxies in front with trusted-proxies.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 按客户端的部分已关闭：只应用全局限制。在 web-protection 上用 enabled="true" 打开它们，或用 trusted-proxies 写明前面的代理。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The ports could not be read
The provider is disabled: nobody signs in through it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 提供商已禁用：没有人通过它登录

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The provider is enabled: people can sign in through it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 提供商已启用：人们可以通过它登录

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The providers people may sign in through instead of a password here. A provider is configured, tested and then enabled; a sign-in gives only the groups its role mappings name.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 人们可以用来登录、而不在此使用密码的提供商。提供商先配置、再测试，然后启用；一次登录只给予其角色映射所指定的组。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The public names this node answers for its local nodes, each for one. A passthrough name's TLS goes to the local node unopened; a terminate name's requests are forwarded. A local node's own setup adds and removes its names too.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点为其本地节点应答的公共名称，每个名称对应一个节点。透传名称的 TLS 原样到达本地节点；终结名称的请求会被转发。本地节点自己的设置也会添加和移除其名称。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The remote's record, changed directly: no rule of its kind, test or review applies, and its stored credentials and keys are shown. Use the configuration above where it offers the change.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 直接更改的远程记录：不适用其类型的规则、测试或复核，并会显示其已存储的凭据和密钥。若上方的配置提供了该更改，请使用它。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The server reaches this provider on the public network only. An instance administrator allows a provider on the instance's own network.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 服务器只能经公共网络到达此提供商。实例管理员可以允许实例自身网络上的提供商。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The SHA-256 of this node's link key. A local node shows it in its Pair step before it pairs: check that the two match
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此节点链路密钥的 SHA-256。本地节点在配对前的配对步骤中显示它：请核对两者一致

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The sign-in policy is not available to you.
The text is received as a message of the type from the remote, then consumed by the type's service, as if the remote had sent it.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 该文本作为来自远程的此类型消息被接收，再由该类型的服务消耗，如同远程发送了它。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The time of the backup the local node was restored from, or a little before
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 本地节点所恢复的那份备份的时间，或稍早一点

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The type's record, changed directly: its services are named as typed, with no owner registration or review. Use the contract above where it offers the change.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 直接更改的类型记录：其服务按所写的名称指定，没有所有者登记，也没有复核。若上方的合同提供了该更改，请使用它。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: These rules are deployment configuration: whoever runs the server sets them in its conf, and they apply to everyone. A group can ask more of its members below.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这些规则是部署配置：运行服务器的人在其配置中设置它们，并对所有人生效。一个组可以在下方对其成员提出更多要求。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This message is not available to you, or there is no such message.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此消息对您不可用，或没有这样的消息。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This message type is not available to you, or there is no such type.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此消息类型对您不可用，或没有这样的类型。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This message's text is not available to you, or there is no such message.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此消息的文本对您不可用，或没有这样的消息。
此节点链路密钥的指纹

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This provider is not available to you, or it does not exist.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此提供商对您不可用，或不存在。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This server's web listeners have not started, so there is nothing to show.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此服务器的 Web 监听尚未启动，因此没有可显示的内容。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Visits by user: the users with visits in a period, with how many and the first and the last.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 按用户统计的访问：一段时期内有访问的用户、次数，以及第一次和最后一次。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Web protection could not be read
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 无法读取 Web 防护
每个本地节点认领了什么

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What each local node's own setup, from its Edge Node wizard, sent besides its host names, and the numbers its copies have. Each name, domain, number and site belongs to one local node: the first to claim it.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每个本地节点自己的设置，从其边缘节点向导发出的、主机名以外的内容，以及其副本的数量。每个名称、域、号码和站点只属于一个本地节点：先认领的那个。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What happens to a node with a new instance id that takes the pairing over while none of its members is linked, such as a standby (New nodes sets it)
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 当其成员都未建立链路时，一个带有新实例 ID 的节点（例如备用节点）接管该配对时会发生什么（由“新节点”设置）
会发生什么，或为什么不会
如何使重复处理保持安全

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What people see on the sign-in page
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 人们在登录页上看到的内容

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What the member says on its link: starting, live, draining or stopping. Only a live member gets new work
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 成员在其链路上报告的状态：启动中、运行中、排空中或停止中。只有运行中的成员接收新工作

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: What this server is limiting, denying and banning, by the web-protection rules of its conf. A rule with hosts applies to those sites only. A ban started on one server is told to the other members of its cluster and to the edge node it is paired with.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此服务器按其配置中的 web-protection 规则在限制、拒绝和封禁什么。带有 hosts 的规则只用于那些站点。在一台服务器上开始的封禁会通知其集群的其他成员以及与它配对的边缘节点。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Where it is listed on the sign-in page
Where the accounts of this instance are signed in. Signing a session out sends its next request to the sign-in page; its user can sign in again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此实例的账号在何处保持登录。退出一个会话会将其下一次请求送到登录页；其用户可以再次登录。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: With none of a pairing's members linked, a node with its key and a new instance id, such as a standby, takes the pairing over. It is admitted and the administrators are told, or it waits for your approval on this page.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 当一个配对的成员都未建立链路时，持有其密钥和新实例 ID 的节点（例如备用节点）会接管该配对。它会被准入并通知管理员，或在此页等待您的审批。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: You would not be admitted from your own address as a member of this group.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 以您自己的地址，您不会被接纳为该组的成员。
